decisions.quote:
Thus, this test suggests the presence of two classes that met the criteria fell short
of the consistency threshold. Because the two classes could not be consistently identified, the
replication has failed.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly conclude that the replication failed because the two prerequisite target latent classes (H1) could not be consistently recovered across draws, precluding the focal test (H*). The shipped outcome quote claiming successful class recovery does not appear in the source report.
